The pause screen swaps the music (in the third S3 run the boss cue's node ended when the pause opened and a new one started on resume), so the Seymour read holds at the command menu instead of pausing. LV394-6 (method): four harness runs of mine are superseded and kept in superseded-first-runs/: the first S1 run stopped on my wrong assumption that ArrowLeft after the typed "anc" returns the cursor to Chapter I (the A key is a left-navigation alias on the board, so the A of "anc" had already moved it); the first S3 run read the head lock through a sampler that needed the lock's own state, which cannot read a page with ?headlock=off, so the sampler was rebuilt from the stage camera and the planes' applied matrices (the lock-on numbers agreed in both runs); the second S3 run had no late read of the Seymour node; and the third read it after pauses that had restarted the cue, so the fourth, the counted run, holds at the command menu instead.
